name: 演化契约与零擅自向后兼容

question.instructions: Evaluate compliance with Evolution Contract: zero unapproved backward compatibility, removal of dead/deprecated code, and clean deprecation.

criteria.passed: Complies with clean deprecation. Dead code, deprecated endpoints or legacy fallbacks are deleted rather than preserved secretly. No unapproved backward-compatibility layers.
criteria.violated: Violates rule: unapproved deprecated code, zombie backward-compatible fallback, dual-track compatibility or hidden compatibility layers introduced.

why: 核心正交架构红线：任何作为向后兼容保留的逻辑必须经用户明确批准后方可保留；旧模型退役必须执行全生命周期逆向清缴。
